description: This file contains utility functions related to the ProspectLists module in SuiteCRM, including JavaScript validation code and a function to generate a new record HTML form.

classes.name: ProspectListFormBase
classes.description: A class providing form functionalities for ProspectLists, specifically generating HTML forms.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript snippet for client-side form validation, particularly checking for missing required fields.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Requires the ProspectListFormBase class and calls its getForm method to generate an HTML form for creating new ProspectList records.
